text:
Situation: Vasopressin 20 USP units/mL 1 mL multidose vial is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 161 units with 36.7 days of supply at 4.4 units per day. Corvale General holds 185.14 units with 29.3 days of supply at 6.3 units per day.

Why (FDA record): The product label (NDC 71872730601) identifies Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC as the labeler and repack plant (FEI 3014288534). FDA inspection 1249077 of that facility ended on 2024-09-11 and was classified VAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2024-11-15.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately one month at both sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. The labeler’s repack facility received a VAI classification in 2024. Alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Inc. (plant FTO-9, VAI 2024-05-17); requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with American Regent, Inc. (plant VAI 2026-06-18); requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc.; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Baxter Healthcare Corporation; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
